nodes.description: Owner address of Relics; only writable through _setOwner which requires msg.sender == wallet
Next token id to mint, initialized to 1 and incremented with an unchecked addition after each mint
Public sale flag gating mintRelic; toggled by startSale/stopSale
Mint enable flag; true means minting still allowed, set false by lockcollection
Hardcoded privileged address 0x5c2B89CBeC1a4996Aa5e81f3dFf8505ABeC6B34c used as authority and payout target
URI stored for every newly minted relic; mutable only by wallet via changeRelicURI
Relics constructor: sets ERC721 name/symbol, tokenCounter = 1 and calls _setOwner(wallet)
Public mint: requires saleStatus and collectionLock, safe-mints tokenCounter to msg.sender, sets URI, increments counter
Owner mint: requires msg.sender == wallet and collectionLock, safe-mints and increments counter at no cost
Updates relicURI; guarded only by msg.sender == wallet
Sets saleStatus = true; guarded only by msg.sender == wallet
Sets saleStatus = false; guarded only by msg.sender == wallet
Sets collectionLock = false, permanently stopping minting; guarded only by msg.sender == wallet
View returning address(this).balance
Withdraws amount wei to msg.sender via transfer after checking msg.sender == wallet and amount <= getBalance()
View returning the _owner state variable
onlyOwner modifier comparing owner() to _msgSender()
Sets owner to address(0) through _setOwner; protected by onlyOwner
Transfers ownership to newOwner through _setOwner; protected by onlyOwner
Private ownership setter that re-checks msg.sender == wallet before writing _owner
ERC721 safe mint: mints token then invokes _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient, enabling an external callback
ERC721 internal mint: validates to != 0 and !_exists(tokenId), then registers ownership
Calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract using Address.functionCall and decodes the returned magic value
Stores relicURI for a token id after checking the token exists
msg.sender: used both as mint recipient/withdraw recipient and as the sole authorization check against wallet
msg.sender.transfer(amount) in withdrawAmount: value transfer driven by msg.sender and amount
tokenCounter = tokenCounter + 1 performed without SafeMath in mintRelic and ownermintRelic
to.functionCall(abi.encodeWithSelector(onERC721Received...)) forwards all gas to an arbitrary contract address
_safeMint performs an external callback into the recipient before tokenCounter is incremented in the minting functions
inputURI parameter of changeRelicURI, written directly into relicURI
amount parameter of withdrawAmount, bound only by amount <= getBalance()
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership/_setOwner, written into _owner
to parameter of _safeMint/_mint, the recipient address that receives the callback
tokenId parameter of _mint, key used for the ownership mapping
oldOwner local variable in _setOwner, assigned the previous _owner and never used

changeRelicURI is gated by require(msg.sender == wallet)
startSale is gated by require(msg.sender == wallet)
stopSale is gated by require(msg.sender == wallet)
lockcollection is gated by require(msg.sender == wallet)
withdrawAmount is gated by require(msg.sender == wallet)
_setOwner re-checks require(msg.sender == wallet) before writing ownership
the withdrawal target is msg.sender, which receives the transferred value
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender()
the constructor calls _setOwner(wallet) to initialize ownership
the constructor initializes tokenCounter to 1
the constructor indirectly sets _owner through _setOwner
_setOwner writes _owner
_setOwner stores the previous owner in the oldOwner local variable
newOwner flows into _setOwner and becomes the new owner
owner() reads _owner
onlyOwner calls owner() to compare with the caller
renounceOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0))
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier
transferOwnership calls _setOwner with the new owner
newOwner is the untrusted argument that becomes the contract owner
mintRelic requires saleStatus to be true
mintRelic requires collectionLock to be true
mintRelic performs the external callback _safeMint before incrementing tokenCounter
mintRelic calls _setTokenURI for the freshly minted token
mintRelic reads relicURI to assign it to the new token
mintRelic increments tokenCounter without SafeMath
mintRelic reads and writes the tokenCounter state variable
ownermintRelic requires collectionLock to be true
ownermintRelic performs the external callback _safeMint before incrementing tokenCounter
ownermintRelic calls _setTokenURI for the freshly minted token
ownermintRelic increments tokenCounter without SafeMath
ownermintRelic reads and writes the tokenCounter state variable
the unchecked increment writes back into tokenCounter
_safeMint calls _mint, which changes ownership state before the external callback returns
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received, the reentrancy entry point
the to address is the recipient passed into _safeMint
the to address is written into ownership storage inside _mint
tokenId is the key used by _mint for the token ownership mapping

stopSale writes saleStatus

relicURI is the value stored by _setTokenURI for each minted token

normalization_plan.reason: inputURI exists only as the argument that changeRelicURI writes into the relicURI state variable
amount exists only as the withdrawal argument bounded by getBalance inside withdrawAmount
newOwner exists only as the ownership argument forwarded from transferOwnership into _setOwner
the to address exists only as the recipient argument consumed by _safeMint and _mint
tokenId exists only as the mint key argument consumed by _mint
oldOwner is a dead local variable assigned inside _setOwner and never read afterwards
